newsitem.title: USA: Transmation completes EIL unit purchase.
newsitem.headline: Transmation completes EIL unit purchase.

text.p: Transmation Inc said on Friday it completed its previously announced $22 million purchase of the sales and service division of EIL Instruments Inc.
The purchase was financed entirely with senior bank debt, Transmation said.
The division acquired includes EIL's test and measurement equipment distribution business, its repair and calibration business and its value-added and meter modification business.
The purchase is expected to bring Transmation's annual sales to nearly $100 million, the company said.
